changelog:
• Strict Fail-Closed Position Close & Panic De-Risk: Enforces 6-step protocol (cancel orders, verify order state, verify exchange positions, submit reduce_only=True, confirm flat post-close) and keeps unresolved/partial positions visible
• Authoritative Order Routing & Limit Execution Semantics: Isolates Testnet orders under exchange authority, preserves Live limit_price/is_stop_entry, and enforces bid/ask quote fills (ask <= limit Buy, bid >= limit Sell) with depth-based partial fills in Paper mode
• India Production Market-Data Isolation: Restricts public WebSocket failover to wss://public-socket.india.delta.exchange with trades/ob_l2/ticker subscriptions and distinguishes Production market data from Demo/Live execution & account scope
• Complete Vela Chart Workspace Persistence: Fixed WebChannel bridge handshake (on_bridge_ready/on_page_ready), Clear All & legend removal across restarts, Pine/native parameter & visibility fidelity, multi-chart independent visible_range, and 7-stage SHA-256 verification
